gumroad.title: US Winery & Distillery Directory 2026 — 82,500+ Producers (CSV)
gumroad.description:
**Every federally-licensed winery, distillery, importer & wholesaler in the United States.**

82,521 records. All 50 states + territories. Direct from TTB Federal Register.

**What's included per record:**
- Permit number (unique federal ID)
- Owner name + Operating name (DBA/trade name)
- Full address: street, city, state, ZIP, county
- Permit type: Wine Producer/Blender | Distilled Spirits Plant (DSP) | Alcohol Importer | Alcohol Wholesaler
- **NEW PERMIT FLAG** — 69 recently licensed openers (high-value segment for vendors)
- TTB source URL for every row (full traceability)

**Direct from TTB Federal Register** — the same dataset WIN Data charges $2,400/year to access. Vinaty charges €395 for international wine contacts. Apify scraper charges $2.50–$3.50 per 1,000 records.

**Who buys this:**
- Equipment suppliers (barrel brokers, bottling lines, tanks) prospecting new wineries & distilleries
- POS platforms (Toast, Arryved) targeting craft beverage producers
- Ingredient vendors (hops, grapes, grains, yeasts) building craft beverage prospect lists
- Packaging companies (bottles, labels, corks, boxes) targeting new openers
- Compliance consultants (TTB permitting, label approval) identifying new licensees
- Insurance brokers (craft beverage liability, property) targeting producers
- Marketing agencies specializing in craft beverage branding

**Important:** Brewery registrations are NOT included — IRC § 6103 classifies brewery data as tax return information and is not publicly available from TTB. This dataset covers wineries, distilleries, importers, and wholesalers only.

**One-time $79 — instant CSV download. No subscription.**
